about: A fast cache server from Microsoft Research that works with Redis clients.

prs.title: Fetching several keys no longer hangs newer Redis clients
prs.broken: Asking for several keys at once, when one was missing, sent back an old-style empty answer. The newest Python Redis client waited forever for data that never came.
prs.changed: Missing keys now get the same empty answer the other commands already use with newer clients.
prs.matters: Apps using current Redis clients no longer freeze on a common command.
